blocks.text: 05-SET / store setup Goes here. Integrating Claude Code directly into a Shopify store using the local development environment (Visual Studio Code, Shopify CLI) to create and edit themes via conversational prompts. Not here. • The strategic layout or structure of the actual landing pages -> 07-LPG • Upgrading a Shopify subscription or configuring backend payment settings -> 05-SET (basic)

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details the exact technical pipeline for installing a headless AI development environment (Visual Studio Code + Anthropic Extension + Shopify CLI) to manipulate live Shopify theme code using conversational prompts. modules: [SET] topics: [Claude Code integration, Shopify CLI, local development, theme editing, AI coding] tier: 3 scope_hint: baseline

Topics. developer environments / installing Visual Studio Code, creating the local folder directory, installing the Anthropic Claude extension, authorizing the workspace; CLI integration / instructing Claude to install the Shopify CLI (NPM version), authenticating the store (shopify auth login), pulling the theme list; theme management / using Claude to duplicate the live theme (e.g., "copy of horizon") to create a safe local staging environment; AI coding / prompting Claude to inject code directly into the theme files (e.g., adding trust badges, creating custom dropdown variant pickers, modifying the cart icon).

The CLI Integration Stack: Opening Visual Studio Code, creating a dedicated "Shopify Editor" folder, installing the Anthropic extension, and prompting Claude to install the Shopify CLI (explicitly choosing the NPM version over Homebrew).

Theme Duplication Protocol: The critical safety step of asking Claude to "duplicate the live theme" and restrict all subsequent coding to that copy, preventing catastrophic breaks on the live storefront.
The "Usage Token" Limit: The warning that heavy Claude Code execution will hit API limits (e.g., "90% of limit used"), requiring a 1-hour cooldown period before further theme coding.
Skip. The promotional pitch for the "Perfect Product Page" framework workbook or generic explanations of what a chatbot is.
Scope mix. 100% growth (advanced headless AI integration). Volume. ~250 words.

07-LPG / landing pages Goes here. Structuring a high-converting product page template using AI to generate trust badges, benefit grids, variant dropdowns, and swiping competitor design elements. Not here. • The technical installation of the Shopify CLI and Claude Code -> 05-SET

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Explains how to use AI coding to generate custom sections and high-converting product page templates that do not natively exist within default Shopify themes. modules: [LPG] topics: [AI web design, product page templates, competitor cloning, variant pickers] tier: 2 scope_hint: growth

Topics. page structuring / creating custom product page templates (e.g., the "Perfect Product Page" framework) featuring hero sections, trust badges, benefit grids, and social proof; custom block creation / using AI to code new editable blocks (e.g., a "Product Trust Buttons" block with editable shipping, guarantee, and return icons placed directly under the add-to-cart button); component modification / converting standard variant pills into dropdown menus; competitor cloning / pasting screenshots of competitor websites into Claude to replicate specific design elements (e.g., cloning a "Top Seller" heart badge from True Classic).
Custom Block Injection: Prompting Claude to build new blocks that appear in the native Shopify theme editor, such as adding three editable trust badge icons specifically underneath the buy buttons.

Competitor Component Cloning: Taking a screenshot of a high-converting competitor feature (e.g., True Classic's "Top Seller" badge on a variant swatch), uploading it to Claude, and instructing the AI to build an exact replica with customizable text and colors in the theme editor.

Global Theme Edits: Prompting Claude to modify global theme utility settings, such as changing the shopping cart icon from a bag to a trolley and allowing the notification bubble color to be customized in the editor.
Skip. The specific command line prompts used to authorize the Shopify connection.
Scope mix. 100% growth (using AI to custom-code landing page elements). Volume. ~250 words.
